subject: RFP: Managed IT Services & Cybersecurity — 2025-2027 Contract
body:
Dear Acme Tech Solutions,

Vantage Health Systems is issuing a formal Request for Proposal for Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity support across our 6 regional facilities. We are seeking a qualified vendor to provide end-to-end IT managed services, including help desk support (Tier 1-3), network monitoring, endpoint management, and HIPAA-compliant cybersecurity services.

Scope of services required:
- 24/7 help desk support covering approximately 850 endpoints
- Network monitoring and management across 6 sites
- Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platform
- Quarterly vulnerability assessments
- Annual penetration testing
- HIPAA compliance advisory and audit support

Contract term: 2 years with one 1-year renewal option.
Estimated annual value: $1.4M - $1.8M.

Please submit your proposal including your approach, team bios, relevant case studies (healthcare preferred), pricing breakdown, and references by May 15, 2026.

The full RFP document is attached. Please acknowledge receipt and confirm your intent to bid by April 30, 2026.

This RFP is being evaluated through our Astra platform. Please respond via the supplier portal or directly to this email.

Regards,
Rachel Thornton
Category Manager, IT & Technology
Vantage Health Systems

subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Updated Cyber Liability Certificate Needed by April 25
body:
Hi Sandra,

This is a reminder that your cyber liability insurance certificate on file with Meridian Capital Group expires on April 25, 2026. Our vendor compliance policy requires an updated certificate of insurance (COI) to be on file before the expiry date to avoid a temporary suspension of purchase orders.

Please upload your updated COI to the Coupa supplier portal at your earliest convenience, or send it directly to our vendor compliance team at compliance@meridiancapital.com.

Required coverage minimums for cyber liability:
- Per occurrence: $2,000,000
- Annual aggregate: $5,000,000

Note: Your current policy (Chubb, policy #CY-2024-TX-11038) shows coverage of $3,000,000 which is below our new minimum requirement of $5,000,000 aggregate effective April 1, 2026. Please confirm with your broker whether your current policy can be endorsed to meet this requirement.

If you have any questions please contact our vendor compliance team.

Thank you,
James Obi
Procurement Operations
Meridian Capital Group

subject: Vendor Onboarding — Documents Required
body:
Dear Acme Tech Solutions team,

Welcome to the Clearfield Financial vendor network! We are excited to formalize our partnership. To complete your onboarding, we need the following documents submitted to our procurement team:

1. Completed W-9 form (2024 version)
2. Certificate of Insurance — General Liability (min $1M per occurrence)
3. Certificate of Insurance — Professional Liability (min $2M)
4. Certificate of Insurance — Cyber Liability (min $2M)
5. Signed Vendor Code of Conduct (attached)
6. Completed Vendor Information Form (attached)
7. SOC 2 Type II report or summary (most recent)
8. ACH payment setup form
9. Company overview / capabilities statement (1-2 pages)

Please note that Clearfield Financial operates under strict financial services regulations. We will also require you to complete our Information Security Questionnaire (attached, 47 questions) prior to final approval.

All documents should be submitted via email to vendors@clearfieldfinancial.com by May 30, 2026.

Thank you for your patience — we typically complete the review process within 10 business days of receiving all required documents.

Best regards,
Priya Anand
Procurement Manager
Clearfield Financial

subject: RFQ-2026-0441: IT Help Desk Staffing Augmentation — Q2/Q3 2026
body:
Good afternoon,

Northstar Manufacturing is requesting quotes for temporary IT Help Desk staff augmentation to cover increased workload during our ERP migration project (SAP S/4HANA rollout, April–September 2026).

Requirements:
- 3x Tier 1 Help Desk Technicians
- 2x Tier 2 Systems Support Specialists
- Start date: April 28, 2026
- Duration: 22 weeks (with possible extension)
- On-site at our Plymouth, MN facility (Mon-Fri, 7am-6pm)
- Must have experience supporting manufacturing floor environments and SAP end-user support

Please provide:
1. Hourly bill rates for each role
2. Your typical ramp time from contract signature to staff on-site
3. Candidate profiles / CVs for available resources
4. Your staffing approach and backup plan if a resource is unavailable

Submit via SAP Ariba RFQ response portal by May 5, 2026.

Greg Halliday
IT Category Buyer
Northstar Manufacturing

subject: Annual Supplier ESG & Diversity Survey — Please Complete by June 15
body:
Dear Valued Supplier,

As part of our commitment to responsible sourcing and supply chain transparency, Vantage Health Systems conducts an annual Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) and Supplier Diversity survey.

This year's survey covers:
- Environmental: Carbon footprint, waste reduction programs, energy sources
- Social: Workforce diversity data, pay equity practices, community investment
- Governance: Ethics & compliance programs, data privacy policies, board diversity
- Diversity certification status and certifying bodies

The survey takes approximately 20-30 minutes to complete and your responses will be used to:
- Inform our supplier diversity reporting to stakeholders
- Support our Scope 3 emissions calculations
- Help us identify partnership opportunities for diverse suppliers

Please complete the survey via the Astra supplier portal by June 15, 2026. If you have questions, contact supplier.relations@vantagehealth.com.

Thank you for your partnership.

Vantage Health Systems
Supplier Relations Team

subject: Vendor Security Questionnaire (SIG-Lite) — Response Needed by November 13
body:
Hi Acme Tech Solutions team,

As the last step before final vendor approval, our Third-Party Risk team needs your responses to the attached Vendor Security Questionnaire (SIG-Lite style, 22 questions). It replaces the earlier 47-question PDF.

For each question, please answer Yes, No, Partial, or N/A, add a short explanation, and reference the supporting evidence (document name and page). We will review the evidence alongside your answers, so please include:

- Your most recent SOC 2 Type II report
- Your latest external penetration test summary, including retest status
- Security awareness and phishing simulation results for the last 12 months
- Your information security / access control policy
- Your most recent user access review

Where your evidence shows an exception or an open finding, please tell us and include your remediation plan and target dates. Incomplete questionnaires will be returned.

Please send everything by November 13, 2026.

Thank you,
Priya Anand
Procurement Manager
Clearfield Financial
